c6:gaziantep house.aciklama: This is a museum about the Whirling Dervishes. It's housed in a fine mansion, and shows displays. It is part of a mosque's "külliye" (Islamic-Ottoman social complex centered around a mosque). It was built in the 17th century. The Mevlevi Lodge Monastery is entered via a courtyard which opens off the courtyard of the mosque. Elsewhere I found it probably belonged to the Tekke Mosque, The mosque was built in 1638 by a Turkmen landowner, Mustafa Aga.

It was built in the 17th century. The Mevlevi Lodge Monastery is entered via a courtyard which opens off the courtyard of the mosque. Elsewhere I found it probably belonged to the Tekke Mosque, The mosque was built in 1638 by a Turkmen landowner, Mustafa Aga.

c6:anatolian garden.baslik: File:Museum of Anatolian Civilizations Hittite Replica of the Fasıllar Monument in 2004 02.jpg
c6:anatolian garden.aciklama: In a village, Fasıllar, a monument from the 13th century BC that was never finished lies on a hill. It’s Turkish name is “Kurt Beşiği” (Wolf's Cradle), although it has nothing to do with wolves. A well-carved Storm God stands with his left leg on the head of the Mountain God. Thew latter stands between two lions. It is one block of rock of about 70 tons, its height is 8 meters and its width is 2.75 meters. A replica stands in the garden of the Ankara museum.

c6:the land of legends.aciklama: تعتبر أرض الأساطير من أبرز معالم السياحة في أنطاليا، ويمتد على مساحة تصل إلى 639 ألف متر مربع في مدينة أنطاليا، وقد تم افتتاحه في العام 2016، ويضم أرض الأساطير أنطاليا مختلف المرافق الترفيهية وخدمات الضيافة الفاخرة، وفندقاً 5 نجوم مصمماً للأطفال خصوصاً، ومرافق ترفيهية لا يوجد لها مثيل على مستوى العالم. ويشكل أرض الأساطير في أنطاليا إضافة إلى حديقتها الخيالية ومدينتها المائية مركزاً ترفيهياً متكاملاً، واستطاعت أن تكون الوجهة الأولى في مدينة أنطاليا استقبالاً للسياح.

Termessos was a Pisidian city built at an altitude of more than 1000 meters at the south-west side of the mountain Solymos (modern day Güllük Dağı) in the Taurus Mountains (modern day Antalya province, Turkey). It lies 30 kilometres to the north-west of Antalya. It was founded on a natural platform on top of Güllük Dağı, soaring to a height of 1.665 metres from among the surrounding travertine mountains of Antalya, which average only 200 metres above sea level.

c6:lpg gas pump.aciklama: LPG Bullets The Bullets, named because of their shape stored Liquefied Petroleum Gases. LPG is the generic name for commercial Propane and commercial Butane. The two smaller vessels V1085 and V1086 stored Propane and were designated as emergency vaporisers for the Refinery Fuel Gas Main. V1092 and V1093 stored a combination of Butane and Propane which was pumped to process units to be separated. V1094 the furthest of the vessels was converted to be a buffer vessel for the Refinery Fuel Gas Main.

c6:red tower alanya historical tower.aciklama: The Kizil Kule (Red Tower) The octagonal shaped building that's the symbol of the city is a work by Selcuks of the 13th century. c6:kemer municipality.aciklama: The photograph depicts a wide shot and the structural design of the Višnjica spring in Dabrica. In the foreground is a massive stone vault (volt), a traditional architectural element built from hewn stone to protect the spring from sunlight, contamination, and external elements. This type of covering allowed for the preservation of lower water temperatures and quality during summer months. Connected concrete troughs forming a functional unit for water distribution are also visible.

This increase is usually caused by technical problems on the road or in the means of transport, other times it is caused by the behavior of drivers on the road. Road safety is often a serious problem both in terms of the number of road victims and the economic cost of these accidents on the Algerian economy. The fight against road safety can be a priority concern of the State and this fight must be waged against the most vulnerable road user

c6:manavgat manavgat coast.aciklama: Side is an ancient Greek city on the southern Mediterranean coast of Turkey, a resort town and one of the best-known classical sites in the country. It lies near Manavgat and the village of Selimiye, 78 km from Antalya in the province of Antalya. It is located on the eastern part of the Pamphylian coast, which lies about 20 km east of the mouth of the Eurymedon River. Today, as in antiquity, the ancient city is situated on a small north-south peninsula about 1 km long and 400 m across.

c6:antalya clouds.baslik: File:Antalya museum Uşak medallion carpet, 16th century carpet 4858.jpg
c6:antalya clouds.aciklama: Uşak medallion carpet, 16th century carpet. It is huge, six or seven meters wide, I'd guess. Uşak (110 km west of Afyon) was one of the most important and renowned carpet centers in Ottoman times (late 15th to 18th century). Rug production is still going on today, but on a lesser level and with altered designs. In the 17th century great quantities of Uşak carpets were made for the royal houses and the Christian churches of Europe. They are named according to their specific design: ‘star’, ‘medal
c6:antalya clouds.nesne: Antalya museum Uşak medallion carpet, 16th century carpet 4858

Powered by a simple but noisy pulsejet that earned it the Allied nicknames of "buzz bomb" and "doodle bug," more than 20,000 were launched at British and continental targets, mostly London and Antwerp, from June 1944 to March 19

c6:mediterranean coastal road.aciklama: Westward view across the buildings above Cala d'Estellencs on the northwestern coast of Mallorca. In the foreground are several traditional Mallorcan-style stone buildings, including the property currently rented as Cala Estellencs House . The Camí de la Mar, one of the two access roads leading down to the cove, passes between the buildings, which are surrounded by retaining walls, stairways and small terraces. Further uphill on the left, another stone house stands on a rocky coastal slope cover

c6:united kingdom flute.aciklama: Flute casts at Donkey Quarry near Broughton in Furness, Cumbria, England. These are excellent turbidite sequence flute casts. Possibly the best exposure in the UK. They are part of the Gawthwaite Formation (425 Ma, Silurian). These are shelf deposits which saw fast flows of sediment settle out into various grades. This is the bottom of a flow which scoured out the seabed (Iapetus) forming these features. They show the bed has been tilted by 90 degrees.

c6:united kingdom flute.aciklama: Flute Casts These knobbly shapes are indicative of turbidites, which are rocks formed by underwater slumps and landslides. The turbulent current carves hollows in the underlying rocks, and the hollows are then filled with sediment. This face is the underside of the flow; the rocks in this quarry have been tilted beyond the vertical. These turbidites are of Silurian age.

Many Turkish cities have an Atatürk Museum, often in a house where the founder of the Turkish Republic stayed at some time, sometimes for just one night. This is the Gaziantep version, for a stay on January 26, 1933, in a house from 1892.

This monument (named ‘Atatürk anıtı’ = Atatürk Memorial) dates from around 1930. Atatürk is portrayed as commander in chief of the Turkish armies. To the left stands a village woman in traditional Türkmen dress, carrying a bouquet of roses. To the right, a militia warrior holds the corner of a carpet; he wears the costume of the local ‘Zeybek’. Zeybeks (or Zeibeks), were irregular militia and guerrilla fighters living in the Aegean Region of the Ottoman Empire from late 17th to early 20th centur

c6:yesiloz.aciklama: Hot Air Ballooning Cappadocia: A must do in Cappadocia is take a balloon ride in order to see the sights from a vantage point like no other. On this 1-hour flight at sunrise you will experience the changing colors and the unique landscapes that scatter the region. Enjoy a unique hot air balloon flight over the fairy chimneys and rock cut churches. This exhilarating experience in Cappadocia is one of the best places around the world to fly with hot air balloons. www.britannica.com/place/Cappadoci
c6:yesiloz.nesne: CAPPADOCIA Göreme National Park and the Rock Sites. World Heritage List. Turkey. Hot Air Ballooning Cappadocia

c6:yesiloz.baslik: File:CAPPADOCIA Göreme National Park and the Rock Sites. World Heritage List. The Fairy Chimneys.jpg
c6:yesiloz.aciklama: THE FAIRY CHIMNEYS In the days before tourism local people called the strange rock cones that surrounded them kales, or 'castles'. Nowadays these amazing structures are usually called peribacalari, or 'fairy chimneys'. They come in an extraordinary range of shapes and sizes but most are tall and phallic-shaped with a cap of harder stone that protects the softer rock underneath from erosion. Eventually these caps fall off, whereupon the wind and rain start to whittle away the cone until eventuall

c6:aksu ministry building.aciklama: It is an artificial lake built 13 kilometers south of Bolu city center. The surface of the lake, whose height is 1217 meters, is 4.5 hectares and its circumference is about 1300 meters. The view of the lake, which is covered with pine, fir, beech, hornbeam and mixed species of trees, is wonderful in every season. On the edge of the lake, which is covered with the extraordinary beauty of nature, there is a cute building, which is the "State Guesthouse" of the Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry.

c6:serenity queen.baslik: File:Sacred Serenity, Gunung Kawi Temple in Bali.jpg
c6:serenity queen.aciklama: Gunung Kawi Temple, also known as Gunung Kawi cliff temple, is an enchanting 11th-century temple and funerary complex nestled in the village of Tampaksiring, Bali. This protected archaeological site spans both banks of the Pakerisan River, captivating visitors with its unique location carved into the rock cliffside. Legend has it that Gunung Kawi Temple got its name from the combination of "Gunung" meaning "mountain" and "Kawi" referring to "sculpture," signifying a temple carved on a mountain.
c6:serenity queen.nesne: Sacred Serenity, Gunung Kawi Temple in Bali

The street originates at the City Gates and leads to the ancient temples and houses of the rich citizens of the ancient city. The name Colonnade(d) Avenue can be found in some historical sources.

c6:antalya antalya city center.aciklama: Kaleiçi is the historic city center of Antalya, Turkey. Until modern times, almost the entire city was confined within its walls. It has structures dating from the Roman, Byzantine, Seljuk, Ottoman and modern Turkish republican eras. The Kaleiçi area is located in the centre-eastern portion of the city along the mediterranean coast fronted by the yacht harbour that dates to the Roman era. The name Kaleiçi means "Inside the Kale" or "Inner Kale" (Kale itself means castle or fortress).

c6:antalya antalya city center.aciklama: Kurshunlu Waterfall Nature Park is located in Aksu district of Antalya province, Turkey, 6-7 km to the east of the city center. The park is famous for a waterfall and a variety of plants and animals. It is one of favourite recreational spots for locals and a famous destination for tourists. On the photo the part of the Kurshunlu waterfall, a pond and surrounding plant variety are shown. The photo was captured in June, 2018.

c6:antalya antalya city center.aciklama: Ruins of Pinara, ancient Lycian city in Asia Minor, close to Fethiye, Antalya Province, Turkey. September, 2025. Pinara, PinalePilleñni The city of Pinara is located on the eastern slopes of the South Antikragos Mountains (Baba Dağı) to the east of Fethiye Bay and overlooks the Xanthos Valley. It was built on terraces rising from 330 meters to 715 meters. It is bordered by the cities of Xanthos in the south and Tlos in the northeast. The Lycian name of the city was Pinale (or Pilleñni). c6:aqua fit.aciklama: There will be no clean water highlights the extreme effects of climate change in Eswatini. Droughts have ravaged the country now and again in the past resulting in shortages of water supply and pollution has worsened the situation at hand. Climate change has also caused frequent heatwaves. This remains an eye opener and a strong motivator to society that employing certain efforts towards mitigating the present and future effects of climate change can be proved to be very important.

Japan Expo is a French professional event show on Japanese popular culture, which takes place at the Paris-Nord Villepinte exhibition center every year at the beginning of July, or even at the end of June over a period of four days. It is a cultural event dedicated to manga, video games, anime, but also to martial arts, fashion, music (J-pop, Jrock, traditional), cinema, traditions and cultures, to young artists and creators, to mechanical sport.

c6:london tourism fair.aciklama: I used to volunteer at the museum in the 1990s. London is a city located in Southwestern Ontario, Canada along the Quebec City–Windsor Corridor. The city has a population of 366,151 according to the 2011 Canadian census. c6:natural stone blocks.aciklama: The "Singing Stone" is a block of blue azurite and green malachite, on display at the American Museum of Natural History in New York City. The block weighs about 3,300 kg and contains about 1,500 kg of copper. It was originally collected in 1891 in Brisbee, Arizona, and first exhibited at the 1893 World’s Fair in Chicago. The name derives from the sounds emanating from the stone during changes in humidity.

Banded iron formations, or BIFs, are unusual, dense sedimentary rocks consisting of alternating layers of iron-rich oxides and iron-rich silicates. Most BIFs are Proterozoic in age (although some are Late Archean), and do not form today - they're “extinct”! c6:car inspection turkey.aciklama: Never thaw foods in a garage, basement, car, dishwasher or plastic garbage bag; out on the kitchen counter, outdoors or on the porch. These methods can leave your foods unsafe to eat. There are three safe ways to thaw food: in the refrigerator, in cold water, or in the microwave. It's best to plan ahead for slow, safe thawing in the refrigerator. Small items may defrost overnight; most foods require a day or two and large items like turkeys may take longer, approximately one day for each 5 pound
c6:car inspection turkey.nesne: Food Safety - Cut Waste in Refrigerators (20120106-OC-AMW-0077)

c6:car inspection turkey.aciklama: A quoi reconnaît-on la puissance industrielle d'un pays ? Le degré de développement de sa construction automobile, est un bon indicateur ! Plakias is a village on the south coast of the Greek island of Crete, in the Rethymno Prefecture, about 30 kilometres south of the city of Rethymno. It is part of the municipality Foinikas. It is surrounded by mountains to the north and the Libyan Sea to the south. The former town of fishermen developed in the last few decades into a tourist resort. The first official notice of Plakias was in 1961, when it was mentioned in a census as the permanent home of six fishermen.

c6:classroom.aciklama: Palamuse Parish School's classroom. This 19th century classroom is now a part of a museum that bears the name of writer Oskar Luts , who studied there and wrote the book Kevade about his schooldays. c6:(boş) protest.aciklama: A group of young men forming a black bloc marching during a demonstration in Jakarta , Indonesia , holding flags and a banner. The words on the banner, which are partly hidden, are "BOS BUTUH KA[M]U / KAMU TIDAK BUTUH [B]OS / JARINGAN ANTI-OTORITARIA[N]", which means "The boss needs you / You do not need the boss / Anti-authoritarian network". The black flag with an "A" in a circle in white on it held by a protester in front of the banner is a well-known anarchist symbol .

Dockyard's construction started in 1227, six years later than the Sultan's conquest of the city, near Kizilkule and finished in one year. The Side of the dockyard overlooking the sea and having five cells with arches is 56.5 metres long and it is 44 metres in depth. c6:kızılkule historical tower.aciklama: The Kizil Kule (Red Tower) The octagonal shaped building that's the symbol of the city is a work by Selcuks of the 13th century. Skip's mother Cele opened a women's clothing store on Lincoln Road and later managed an Elizabeth Arden store in Surfside. Skip was an award winning football and baseball player during high school, received a baseball scholarship for the University of M

Aerial photograph of the Recor furniture factory at Hasselt, Belgium, which would close in 2020. Nikon D60 f=55mm f/9 at 1/320s ISO 800. Contrast and colours enhanced using Nikon NX Studio 1.3.2. Perspective corrected and aircraft wing erased using GIMP 2.10.34.

The factory was built by the carriage master Friedrich Johann Melzer, the father of the architect Roman Fedorovich Melzer (1860 -1943, one of the leaders of St. Petersburg modernist style) who arrived from Prussia. The factory became one of the largest enterprises in the city, producing high-quality furniture, and the owner was awarded the title "Supplier of His Imperial Majesty."

c6:furniture factory fire.aciklama: Co-op furniture factory The former Co-op furniture factory in Belmont Row. The archway at the end furthest from the photographer has the inscription "Workpeople and Goods Entrance"!

The tide is out and the receding waters have exposed a vast expanse of beach. Holkham beach consists of many miles of clean golden sands, white sand dunes, mud and shingle patches and an area designated for naturists; there are no beach huts or deck chairs. c6:antalya hair styling.aciklama: Discovered in 1981 in the Gallery of Claudius Peison at the South Bath of Perge. Using two colours marble, black for hair and clothing, white for face, neck and arms. 103 pieces had to be put together during reconstruction. The obvious movement of the figure led to the dance-interpretation. This is a second century copy of an original from the Rococo style of the Hellenistic period. Source: Sculptures of the museum in Antalya (booklet in shop).

c6:recycled art exhibition.aciklama: Artwork “Ser o no Ser” (2012) by Venezuelan artist Honys Torres, an assemblage made with acrylic on canvas and recycled materials, measuring 120 × 120 cm. Through the use of reused objects and materials, the piece offers a critical reflection on social tensions and the fragility of the human condition. This work was awarded 1st Prize in Painting at the XXXII National Art Salon “7 de Diciembre” 2012, held in Maturín, Venezuela.

c6:agricultural field turkey.aciklama: Satellite image of crops growing in Kansas , United States . Healthy, growing crops are green. Corn would be growing into leafy stalks by late June (when this photo was taken). Sorghum , which resembles corn, grows more slowly and would be much smaller and therefore, possibly paler. Wheat is a brilliant gold as harvest occurs in June. Fields of brown have been recently harvested and plowed under or lie fallow for the year. The circular crop fields are a characteristic of center pivot irrigation

c6:amphitheater.aciklama: Amphitheater of the ancient roman city of Italica , today municipality of Santiponce , near Seville, Spain. The amphitheater was built during the reign of emperor Hadrian (117-138) and, with a capacity of 25,000 spectators, was one of the biggest amphitheaters in the Roman Empire. Italica was the first roman city in Hispania and was founded in 206 BC by the great Roman general Publius Cornelius Scipio (later given the nickname Africanus ) to settle his victorious veterans from the Second Punic W

c6:amphitheater.baslik: File:Anfiteatro de Pula, Croacia, 2017-04-16, DD 01-06 PAN.jpg
c6:amphitheater.aciklama: Panoramic view of the interior of the Pula Arena , an amphitheatre located in Pula , Croatia . This Roman edifice was constructed between 27 BC and 68 AD and is among the largest surviving Roman arenas in the world. At the same time, is the best preserved ancient monument in Croatia and the only remaining amphitheater having all four side towers with all three Roman architectural orders entirely preserved. This is a a photo of a cultural heritage in Croatia with ID: Z-863.

c6:title deed document turkey.aciklama: Lotto carpets can be recognized by their consistent color combinations and striking design, traceable to sources in Central Asia. In the central field, stylized yellow leaf patterns stand out against a red ground. The border is filled with cartouches on a dark blue background, and a simplified vine meanders along the outermost edge. These vegetal patterns evoke paradise in Islamic contexts. Made primarily for export in the western Turkish center of Ushak between the 1400s and 1600s, Lotto carpet

c6:title deed document turkey.aciklama: This rare Ottoman embroidery features a floral bouquet that enriches the field under an elegant arch of gilt-metal thread. Flanked by vines of tulips and irises on a silver-metal-thread ground, vases of tulips and jonquils within cartouches adorn the main border and the well-turned corners, a sign of high quality. c6:title deed document turkey.aciklama: Probably the portrait of Abdullah Efendi (1680?–1743). This clergyman of Greek descent was working at the court from 1718 as Shaykh al-Islām and was deposed after the Revolution of 1730. He was exiled, but returned to Istanbul in silence, where he died in 1743. Abdullah owned a large collection of legal and religious documents and was instrumental in the introduction of the printing press in the Ottoman Empire.

c6:title deed document turkey.baslik: File:Carle Vernet - Saddled Arabian Horse in Courtyard - 2008.398 - Cleveland Museum of Art.tif
c6:title deed document turkey.aciklama: While his father, Joseph, was known for marine paintings, and his son, Horace, became a celebrated Romantic artist, Carle Vernet excelled in representing battles and animals, especially horses. Vernet was an expert rider himself, and in his pictures he precisely described various breeds and horse dressings. Although the artist never traveled further from France than Italy, his drawing of an Arabian horse contains elements that make it seem as if he observed the animal in its native environment.

c6:mediterranean sea earthquake map.aciklama: It was built between 1396 and 1421 by the Grand Master Philibert de Naillac before the development of the cannons on the mole east of the Gate of Saint Paul that closes the commercial harbour. It had a square shape like many other medieval towers and was 46 m (145 ft.) high. It was the terminal of the wall belt facing the harbour and was used as a watch tower. It was severely damaged during the earthquakes of 19th century and was demolished by the Ottoman administration [Wikipedia.org]

c6:antalya environment.aciklama: In Olympos Beydağları National Park, there is a profusion of thriving reeds. These elongated plants, characterized by their height and slimness, grow closely together in lush groups throughout the park's wetland regions, including marshes, rivers, and lakes. The reeds play a crucial role in the park's ecosystem by offering a habitat and protective covering for a diverse range of birds, insects, and aquatic creatures. c6:antalya environment.baslik: File:River in Olympos Beydağları National Park.jpg
c6:antalya environment.aciklama: The surviving remnants of Olympos, which can be found today, are primarily situated at the estuary of a fast-moving river that flows from east to west, ultimately reaching the sea. On both sides of the river, there are harbors, with the ancient city being divided by a canal that contained the river's course. The canal served as a pier on both sides, connected by a bridge. Presently, one pillar of the bridge remains intact, standing in its original location.

c6:antalya environment.baslik: File:Tree in Olympos Beydağları National Park.jpg
c6:antalya environment.aciklama: Olympos National Park boasts a wide range of magnificent trees that enhance the scenery with their inherent splendor. The forested regions are primarily dominated by towering evergreen trees like majestic pines and firs, whose impressive heights allow their lofty tops to extend skyward. These coniferous trees create a lush green covering, forming a vibrant canopy that provides shade and refuge for the park's diverse plant and animal life.

c6:antalya necropolis museum.aciklama: Medaillon Sarcophagus. Marble L: 191 cm. H: 78 cm. Roman Period, 2nd century A.D. Perge, Western Necropolis - A.380 The gable-shaped lid contains floral akroterion on the corners and an omphalos in the pediment. The antefixes at the end of the carved roof tiles have lion-heads. Each of the four sides of this sarchophagus has a carved Medusa head in a medallion; those on the long sides of the tomb are supported by Nikai at one side and by Erotes on the other. c6:antalya necropolis museum.aciklama: ARIADNE ON THE SARCOPHAGUS LID Marble L: 274 cm. W: 131 cm. H: 120 cm. Roman Period 2nd century A.D. Perge Found in the Western Necropolis in 1995. Only the lid of this superbly carved large sarcophagus has been found to date. It has Ariadne, the wife of Dionysos, represented asleep upon it, with the trace of a lizard carved by her feet. The face was damaged during its illegal excavation. Source: pdf of the museum found on the internet.

Perge, Western Necropolis Sarcophagus carrying a cline scene upon the lid. As recorded in the inscription on the lid, Aurelia Botiane Demetria is reclining with her husband. The husband's head isn't carved in detail, but just blocked in. The figures carved between the columns on the body of the sarcophagus represent philosophy, wisdom etc. On the back of the sarcophagus are several carved scenes

c6:water infrastructure maintenance.baslik: File:Overhead water tank rural Raichur Karnataka India water tower.jpg
c6:water infrastructure maintenance.aciklama: Overhead water tank (water tower) in a village in Raichur district, Karnataka, India. The structure consists of a reinforced concrete storage tank elevated on columns, with a spiral staircase for access and maintenance. Such water towers are used in rural water supply systems to store water and distribute it through gravity-fed pipelines. These systems are common in villages across India, ensuring reliable domestic water supply in areas where groundwater or piped water infrastructure is limited

c6:eco art exhibition.aciklama: Earls Court exhibition centre, SW5 The Warwick Road entrance showing that George Michael will be in concert for his 'Final Two' on August 24th & 25th 2008. At the time of its opening in 1937, Earl's Court Exhibition Centre was the world's largest re-inforced concrete structure (designed by C. Howard Crane). It was built on a site that had a history for hosting exhibition events, eg that of Buffalo Bill in 1887.

Fokus pada gambar tersebut adalah sebuah Hortensia yang berwarna biru yang disekelilingnya juga terdapat bunga hortensia lain dengan warna, merah, kuning, ungu, krem, dan putih yang sama indahnya meskipun tidak terlalu difokuskan. Pulau Menjangan, yang terkenal akan habitat liar rusanya, menjadi suatu daya tarik tersendiri. Sebagai upaya menjaga kelestarian kawasan serta habitat alami pulau ini, pengunjung dilarang untuk memberikan makanan kepada satwa liar. Hal ini membuat kawanan rusa harus berjuang dalam kehidupannya; bergantung pada alam termasuk mencari makanan dan mempertahankan diri, terlihat dari tanduk seekor rusa pada foto ini yang tersisa sebelah saja.

cf:File:2023 Amsterdam, KNSM-eiland, Lev.aciklama: Gezicht vanaf de Levantkade op het voormalige pand van de Nieuwe Rijnvaart Maatschappij (NRM) op het KNSM-eiland, Oostelijk Havengebied, Amsterdam. Het leegstaande pand werd in 1980 gekraakt door kunstenaars en stond bekend als "Levantkade 10". Thans zijn er sociale huurwoningen, bedrijfsruimtes en ateliers in gevestigd. Het roze gebouw rechts werd bij de renovatie toegevoegd op de plek van een gesloopte loods.

c6:kapali yol.aciklama: Picture shows the turning circle where 2 cars are parked at the end of a cul-de-sac. The main building looks like a semi-detached house but consists of 4 maisonettes, that is 4 flats (2 up, 2 down) with separate entrances, the upstairs ones being on the sides of the building. It is part of a 1930s estate all of the same design with shared grassed areas behind. The rear of dwellings on the next road can be seen behind. The roof is tiled. The walls are brick with render cover apart from decorative

An urban, unplanned cul-de-sac. This short cul-de-sac in an old, established neighbourhood that was laid out on a grid, shows a necessary adaptation to reduce through traffic where there are a lot of school children. The green and benches add a relaxing point.

Perge, Western Necropolis - A.380 The gable-shaped lid contains floral akroterion on the corners and an omphalos in the pediment. The antefixes at the end of the carved roof tiles have lion-heads. Each of the four sides of this sarchophagus has a carved Medusa head in a medallion; those on the long sides of the tomb are supported by Nikai at one side and by Erotes on the other. c6:antalya hotels.aciklama: يتألف الفندق من 320 وحدة سكنية. يتم الترحيب بالضيوف في بهو الإستقبال حيث يتواجد مكتب خدمات لإتمام إجراءات الوصول أو المغادرة. يؤمن المصعد الوصول إلى الطوابق العليا بكل راحة. يساهم توافر الخدمات والتجهيزات مثل شماعة ملابس وخزنة ومكتب صرافة وصراف آلي في تأمين إقامة مريحة. تتوفر في الأماكن العامة إمكانية الإتصال بالإنترنت السلكي (مقابل دفع رسوم إضافية) والإنترنت اللاسلكي. يحتوي الفندق فيما يخص مرافق تقديم الأطعمة والمشروبات على مطعم وقاعة طعام وصالة فطور ومقهى وبار. هناك سوبرماركت لتأمين الاحتياجات

c6:baby high chair product safety.aciklama: The harness consists of single-color, riveted leather straps with glued white felt padding and no decorations. The shoulder straps are not adjustable. The position of the fastener on the back prevents the child from taking it off by themselves. The anchor straps are attached to D-rings with carabiners and riveted to the chest strap in a fixed position below the arms. Small children do not have sufficient grip strength to open the carabiners by themselves. This model probably originates from West

cf:File:Bagdad-Bahn, 13. April 1917.jpg.aciklama: Bagdad-Bahn, "Münster 4827", 13. April 1917. There was a section of the Baghdadbahn in the Taurus Mountains which was extremely difficult to build, with several tunnels whose construction caused delays. To speed up construction, the enginners decided to lay 600 mm gauge track through the unfinished section to allow construction on the section onward to proceed. This also included locomotives and rolling stock, which were moved across the section in a semi-dismantled state on transporter wagons.

c6:taurus mountains documentary.aciklama: Bagdad-Bahn, "Münster 4827", 13. April 1917. There was a section of the Baghdadbahn in the Taurus Mountains which was extremely difficult to build, with several tunnels whose construction caused delays. To speed up construction, the enginners decided to lay 600 mm gauge track through the unfinished section to allow construction on the section onward to proceed. This also included locomotives and rolling stock, which were moved across the section in a semi-dismantled state on transporter wagons.

c6:good party.aciklama: ​1948年，蒋介石在美国大选中支持杜威。北平一支为杜威助威的队伍共20多人，抬着贴有杜威画像的大象（象征共和党），举着写有“杜威好运”“Good_Luck_Dewey”的横额、旗子，敲锣打鼓，由故宫神武门出发向东，沿紫禁城外向南，经南池子、长安左门等处后，回故宫午门东侧，沿紫禁城外向北回到神武门。据说这些人是从杠房（在丧事中抬棺材的机构）雇来，大象是裱糊铺（为丧事制作用来焚烧的纸人纸马的机构）扎的。当时正值国共内战白热化，这出闹剧并未引发任何关注。

The meal is authentically presented on a fresh banana leaf placed over a dark wooden platter. The product, part of the "Hierbas Selectas" line from the Mexican brand Terana, is a key herb in Mexican cuisine. The multilingual label identifies the contents as "Epazote" in flakes. The jar is held in hand, and its cap is sealed with a transparent film ensuring "Calidad Terana" (Terana Quality).

The San Francisco cable car system is the world's last manually operated cable car system and an icon of the city of San Francisco. While the cable cars are used to a certain extent by commuters, the vast majority of the millions of passengers who use the system every year are tourists and the wait to get on can often reach two hours or more. They are among the most significant tourist attractions in the city.

c6:wedding rings close up.aciklama: We bought our engagement rings in Nottingham. A's is made of white gold and has a tiny diamond in it (we were saving up to go travelling at the time, she would have killed me if I'd blown it all on a ring...) and mine is made of titanium. Our wedding rings were an impulse purchase after 4 days of travelling - we got them in Tokyo and they're made of stainless steel... Again A's has a diamond in it. She can't wear it on the same finger as her engagement ring cos it would wear away the gold.

c6:children participating in educational.aciklama: About 200 children of employees at NASA's John C. Stennis Space Center visited the facility for annual Take Our Children to Work activities July 27. Participants enjoyed a windshield tour of the rocket engine test site and various demonstrations and presentations on such topics as cryogenics, the Gulf of Mexico oil spill, computer safety and robotics. They also had an opportunity to take photos at the astronaut suit exhibit and participate in StenniSphere activities.

c6:polsan.aciklama: Fiskebåten GG 195 Normy från Hälsö som hittade den minsprängda u-båten Ulven på position latitud nord 57 grader 45,05 minuter och longitud ost 11 grader 26,8 minuter, den 5 maj 1943 efter tre veckors intensivt sökande sydväst Stora Pölsan i Göteborgs norra skärgård.

c6:polsan.baslik: File:Draken I class submarine Ulven, Scale model.jpg
c6:polsan.aciklama: ULVEN sjösattes 1930 och tjänstgjorde i Svenska Flottan till 1943 då hon 15 april minsprängdes under en övning sydväst om Stora Pölsan utanför Göteborgs norra skärgård. Efter tre veckors sökande hittade man ULVEN den 5 maj och under sommaren bärgades ubåten med de 33 omkomna besättningsmännen ombord. Händelsen har gått tilll eftervärlden som Ulvenkatastrofen. Från originalbåten ULVEN har Sjöhistoriska museet bland annat även en telefonboj, livboj, stävmärken och namnplåt, liksom några personliga
c6:polsan.nesne: Draken I class submarine Ulven, Scale model

c6:polsan.aciklama: HMS Ulven var en ubåt i Draken -klass som var i tjänst i svenska flottan mellan åren 1931 och 1943. Den ingick tillsammans med ubåtarna HMS Gripen (1928) och HMS Draken (1926) i Göteborgseskadern. Under övning i uläge sprängdes ubåten, troligen av en tysk mina, den 15 april 1943 i den så kallade Ulvenkatastrofen. Hela besättningen på 33 man omkom. Först efter 19 dagar kunde en fiskebåt lokalisera HMS Ulven på 52 meters djup sydväst om ön Stora Pölsan och efter ytterligare tre månader bärgades vr

c6:agricultural irrigation system.aciklama: Satellite image of crops growing in Kansas , United States . Healthy, growing crops are green. Corn would be growing into leafy stalks by late June (when this photo was taken). Sorghum , which resembles corn, grows more slowly and would be much smaller and therefore, possibly paler. Wheat is a brilliant gold as harvest occurs in June. Fields of brown have been recently harvested and plowed under or lie fallow for the year. The circular crop fields are a characteristic of center pivot irrigation

cf:File:Antalya Museum dervishes object.aciklama: Begging bowl (keşkül). Originally they would be made of the shell of an Indian coconut-like fruit. To overcome pride and conceit dervishes were required to beg, or rather “accept gifts as a blessing from God” – since begging itself was forbidden. The bowls could be made of any material as long as they looked like the original ones, so ones of silver with gold inlay are known. They would hang from the arm on chains.

c6:airport fuel spill.aciklama: The island of Mauritius has declared a ‘state of environmental emergency’ after a grounded vessel began leaking tonnes of oil into the Indian Ocean. Satellite images, which show the dark slick spreading in the nearby waters, are being used to monitor the ongoing spill. The MV Wakashio vessel, reported to be carrying nearly 4000 tonnes of oil, ran aground on a coral reef on Mauritius’s southeast coast on 25 July. According to media reports, more than 1000 tonnes of fuel have leaked from the crack

c6:airport fuel spill.baslik: File:Niger, Niamey, Boulevard du 15 Avril, Route Nationale No.1 (11), railway, accident.jpg
c6:airport fuel spill.aciklama: A charred fuel tanker truck lies close to the airport in Niamey (Niger) on the Niamey-Dosso railway tracks. The truck overturned on the night from 5 to 6 May 2019 and started leaking. People then started to collect spilled fuel. Shortly after, the truck exploded, killing some 58 people and some 20 more in the days thereafter. The accident received global media coverage.
